basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old living in Boston, trying to navigate the complexities of life with a background shadowed by a narcissistic family. I've recently moved here and I'm working as a freelance graphic designer which gives me the flexibility to explore my interests, primarily anime and local food spots. I spend my evenings browsing Reddit, usually between 7 PM and midnight. Currently single, I'm focusing on self-improvement and emotional healing.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Having grown up in a challenging family environment, I've spent a lot of time self-educating on mental health and personal development through online resources. My professional skills in graphic design are self-taught with a mix of online courses and practical experience.
